MANIKANDA PRABU S
smanikandaprabu2005@gmail.com https://github.com/smanikandaprabu2005
https://www.linkedin.com/in/manikanda-prabu-s +91 9994103347 Sivakasi
SUMMARY
Artificial Intelligence and Data Science undergraduate with hands-on experience in machine learning, full-stack development, and
real-time data applications. Skilled in building AI-driven systems, predictive models, and scalable web applications using Python
and MERN stack technologies. Passionate about solving real-world problems using data science, deep learning, and intelligent
systems.
EDUCATION
B.Tech – Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Mepco Schlenk Engineering College, Sivakasi
CGPA: 7.9 / 10 (till 5th semester)
Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC), Vinayakar Matriculation Higher Secondary School, Sivakasi
Score: 86%
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming Languages: Python, Java, C
Web Development: HTML, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MERN Stack
Databases: MySQL, MongoDB
PROJECTS
Stock Price Prediction System
Developed a machine learning application to predict stock price trends using historical financial data. Integrated Yahoo Finance
API to fetch real-time market data. Built an interactive React.js dashboard for visualizing trends and generating buy/ sell insights.
Tech Stack: Python, React.js, Yahoo Finance API
ATM Anomaly Detection using CLIP Autoencoder
Designed an AI-based anomaly detection system for ATM surveillance videos using a CLIP-based autoencoder model.
Implemented real-time anomaly detection using PyTorch and Transformer-based architectures. Enhanced security monitoring by
detecting abnormal activities in financial surveillance systems.
Tech Stack: Python, PyTorch, CLIP, NumPy
Fuel & Fix – Online Fuel Delivery and Mechanical Assistance Platform
Built a web platform for on-demand fuel delivery and emergency mechanical assistance services. Implemented route optimization
using mapping APIs and location tracking. Integrated a chatbot support system to assist users during emergencies.
Tech Stack: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Leaflet API
Disaster Intelligence Platform
Developed an AI-powered disaster early warning system for floods, cyclones, and landslides. Integrated real-time weather data
and news alerts for dynamic risk monitoring. Applied deep learning models and geospatial data analysis to improve disaster
preparedness.
Tech Stack: Python, TensorFlow/ PyTorch, React.js, MySQL
ACHIEVEMENTS
Domain Winner – Resilience Category | AITHON 2026 (National Level)
Developed an AI-driven Disaster Intelligence Platform leveraging deep learning and geospatial data to improve disaster
preparedness.
Sprintathon 2025 – St. Joseph's College of Engineering
Selected among Top 100 teams out of 2000+ participants and competed in the final 24-hour hackathon round.
Texus'25 Hackathon – SRM Institute of Science and Technology
Participated in a national-level hackathon focused on innovative technology solutions.
Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025
Selected through the internal college hackathon round.
CERTIFICATIONS
AI Agents Intensive Industry 4.0 and Internet Human Computer Technical English Course –
Program – Google (via of Things – NPTEL Interaction – NPTEL IEEE
Kaggle)
